copy.intro: Sourcing a travel gearbox (travel reduction unit) for the Caterpillar 306 mini excavator. This is the ~6 t class final reduction between the travel motor and the track frame — the unit that carries the machine weight and converts motor speed into track pull. We match it against the OEM number, the machine serial and the tag on the existing gearbox before quoting, because the model name alone does not settle the configuration on these machines.
copy.sourcing: Caterpillar undercarriage parts are the deepest aftermarket category in China, with several established manufacturers producing travel reduction units for the mainstream excavator families. We source against the OEM number and the machine serial, not against the model name alone.
copy.fit_check: On the Caterpillar 306, four things have to line up before a travel gearbox can be confirmed: the reduction ratio, the travel-motor mounting interface, the sprocket hub pattern, and the track-frame bolt spacing. Any one of them can differ between build years of the same model. Send a photo of the tag on the existing unit together with the machine serial and we verify all four against the factory data sheet.
copy.pn_note: Catalog numbering for the Caterpillar 306 varies by serial number and build region. Send a photo of your travel-motor nameplate and your machine serial number, and we will identify the correct unit for you before quoting.
copy.generation_note: Caterpillar reuses model numbers across several undercarriage generations, and the travel reduction unit is not carried over between them. A 320 GC and a 320D, or a 325B and a 325C, can share a model name and still take a different gearbox housing, ratio and sprocket hub. Always read the unit against the machine serial, not the model badge.
